- Target list price to FastScale: $0.012/token equivalent (annualized commitment)
- CloudBridge is asking for 15% channel margin (reseller commission) and wants an explicit pass-through line on the PO

Can you confirm whether the above is feasible from Redwood's side? If 15% straight margin is a problem, can you suggest alternatives (co-sell credit, separate rebate, or a tiered margin)? We need a draft PO and pricing sheet to circulate to procurement by COB Monday.

Hi Sophie — great to hear FastScale enjoyed the demo. Looping in Monica (Pricing) and Karthik (Channel) to weigh in on margin impact and recommended structures. Quick thoughts before they reply:

- 15% partner margin is on the higher side for our standard PO band for marketplace private offers but not an automatic no — it depends on committed spend and term.
- If FastScale can commit to a 12–18 month annualized spend target (preferably pre-paid or committed monthly), we can be more flexible.
- We prefer to keep the primary discount applied in a single line in the private offer (list price reduction) rather than multiple credits; post-bill rebates complicate accounting for our marketplace operations team.

Monica/Karthik — can you draft a couple of options (tiered margin vs. fixed 15% but with program credits) and an updated pricing worksheet? Sophie wants a PO draft by COB Monday (10/05).

Hey all — I ran the numbers and attached a quick worksheet (pricing-model-v2.xlsx) with three options. High-level summary below:

Option A — Priority (higher commitment)
- Term: 12 months, committed $480k annualized
- Effective price to FastScale: $0.0118/token equivalent
- Channel margin: 12% pass-through on invoice (CloudBridge listed as reseller)
- Gross margin hit: ~24% for Redwood
- Pros: meets FastScale price close to target; straightforward PO line item

Option B — 15% margin (requested)
- Term: 12 months, committed $600k annualized OR 18 month minimum
- Effective price to FastScale: $0.0115/token eq (with Redwood absorbing incremental cost)
- Channel margin: 15% pass-through
- Additive: 8% marketing rebate to CloudBridge to be issued quarterly as separate accounting credit
- Gross margin hit: ~18% (lower)
- Note: needs finance sign-off; we should treat the 8% rebate as a co-op marketing budget vs. a product discount

Option C — Lower partner margin + co-sell credit
- Term: 12 months, committed $360k
- Channel margin: 10% on invoice + $40k co-sell credit payable after first closed milestone (90 days)
- Effective price to FastScale: $0.0120/token eq
- Pros: preserves unit margin, simpler marketplace ledger entries

Recommendations:
1) If FastScale needs 15% to keep CloudBridge engaged, push for higher commitment (Option B) so we can support that margin.
2) If FastScale cannot increase commitment, Option C gives a clean invoice with a separate co-sell commitment that can be funded from our channel budget.

I attached the worksheet with line-item math and a draft PO stub for Marcus to share (pricing-model-v2.xlsx). Finance will need to sign off on Option B if we proceed.

— Monica
